title: Ask a question: put the verb first
objective: Make yes/no questions by moving the verb to the front, and use hvad, hvor and hvornår.
explanation: To ask a yes/no question, start with the verb: “Du taler engelsk.” → “Taler du engelsk?” With a question word, the question word comes first and the verb second: “Hvor bor du?”, “Hvad laver du?”, “Hvornår kommer toget?”. Danish has no helper verb like English “do”.
sourceReference: Deepwater original starter course (2026-10-29), written for Echo; teacher review required before publishing.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: Right. The verb comes first: “Taler du engelsk?”
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: Start with the verb: “Taler du engelsk?” Danish has no “do”.

exercises.prompt: Complete: “___ bor du?” (Where do you live?)
Turn into a question: “Du kommer i morgen.”
exercises.feedbackCorrect: Correct: the verb moves to the front.

exercises.prompt: Write three questions you would ask someone at a party: one yes/no question and two with hvad, hvor or hvornår.
